provenance: Manually classified from the leading parenthetical fields of 5730 provables in 840 Notes documents, 2026-10-20. No document was modified.
matching: Match a complete plain-text field after trimming surrounding whitespace. Ignore formatting wrappers. Never match a surname substring inside a name or mathematical subtree.
remaining_fields: After extracting years and exact attribution fields, preserve every remaining field in source order as a name or alias. Do not use a theorem-name keyword list.
spelling: Retain source spelling, accents, hyphens and grouping. This is a field classification list, not a canonical person database; do not split hyphenated fields or correct spellings.
year_extraction: Extract complete year fields. Also split a trailing year from an otherwise exact attribution field, as in Levy 1934. Do not extract embedded years from names such as Frobenius' 1912 Theorem.

leading_parenthesis_exceptions.action: Treat the position immediately after the original d/dt mathematical subtree as the missing closing parenthesis. Extract Product Rule for plus that subtree as the name, preserving the mathematical structure. Consume the following period and separating space; retain If and the remaining statement as the body.
leading_parenthesis_exceptions.scope: User-approved one-off exception for this node only. Match through formatting wrappers, but skip and report if the expected source structure differs. Do not repair unrelated unclosed parentheses.
